question: Which specific model claims can the independent Infineon EVAL_2.5KW_CCM_4PIN / AN201408 reference test?

reference_identity.title: 2.5 kW PFC evaluation board with CCM PFC Controller ICE3PCS01G

primary_documents.author: Cioploiu Iulian (IFAT PMM SCOM)
primary_documents.host: static.chipdip.ru mirror of the Infineon-authored AN

reference_identity.revision_note: The AN/board is from 2015. Device package/order codes may have later revisions; only this Rev 1.2 is captured here.

populated_circuit.evidence_base: AN_201408_PL11_027 Rev 1.2 Table 1 p.4, Table 2 pp.14-16, Figure 6 p.12, section 8 p.17
populated_circuit.topology: single-switch CCM boost PFC, average-current control
populated_circuit.default_configuration: 4-pin source-sense (standard setting; J7 closed). 3-pin selectable by opening J7 and closing J6 or J8.

gate_driver.note: EiceDRIVER Compact, isolated CT, 6 A output headline, separate Out+/Out- joined on this board

boost_switch.note: 600 V CoolMOS C7, ~19 mOhm / 40 mOhm class cited in text (19 mOhm in section 1.5, 40 in the order code R040)

candidates.where: section 1.3 p.4; reference 3 p.29; Figure 12/13 captions p.20; presentation slide 5
Figure 6 schematic raster p.12 (read at 400 dpi, low confidence)

boost_diode.note: Same document names three different MPNs. Exact populated diode identity is NOT resolvable from this source; do not select one.

input_rectifier.note: Two 25 A 800 V bridges drawn in parallel from the AC line to the DC rail (schematic p.12). No forward-drop curve given.

boost_inductor.mpn: hand-wound; 2 x Magnetics 77083A7 Kool Mu toroid, 64 turns 1.15 mm wire
boost_inductor.note: section 8 p.17. Small-signal at 100 kHz; no L-vs-bias, tolerance or hot DCR data.

candidates.where: Figure 12/13 captions p.20 ('@ 65 kHz & 100 kHz 3.3 ohm')
Table 2 component list: R7, R11 = 10 ohm

gate_resistor.note: Turn-on and turn-off outputs are joined on this board, so the path is nominally symmetric, but the populated resistance value is unresolved.

gate_bias_v.note: Driver supply rail not stated numerically in the captured pages. UNKNOWN.

input_fuse.note: section 3.1 p.7 explicitly: AC input side includes no fuse; external protection required.

mpn: ICE3RBR4765JZ CoolSET (presentation slide 5; not in Table 2)
auxiliary.note: auxiliary rail generation exists; its loss is not itemised

cooling.note: Two 60 mm fans (M1, M2 PMD1206PTB1-A); dedicated bridge fan with R28 speed trim; DUT heatsink has parallel heat/cool with setpoint via R4 (standard 50 C)

measured_operating_points.units_note: as printed; VIN/VOUT are the board's own sense points

measured_operating_points.note: closest table row to the C1 nominal input power (1796.31 W); same board, not the C1 line/frequency/device set
low-line current-limited end of the captured table; exceeds the C1 15 A true-RMS ceiling

measured_operating_points.conditions: CCM PFC at 1.2 kW, package comparison 3-pin vs 4-pin
measured_operating_points.claim: up to 8% lower switching losses, ~3.5 W saved, ~0.3% full-load efficiency
measured_operating_points.evidence_class: manufacturer claim, no waveform or per-device energy shown

measured_operating_points.claim: 6 A driver output needed to switch the ~19 mOhm CoolMOS

measured_operating_points.conditions: heatsink 60 C, gate 3.3 ohm, 65 kHz and 100 kHz, 4-pin and 3-pin
measured_operating_points.measured_quantity: whole-board efficiency vs Pout, 85 Vac and 230 Vac
measured_operating_points.evidence_class: graphical whole-board efficiency; no per-device data

startup_waveform.where: Figure 19 p.27 (soft-start, low line, 1 kW); line-frequency/DC envelope, not a switching-cycle capture

device_junction_temperature.note: only a 60 C heat-sink setpoint (test) and 50 C standard setpoint (section 3.4) are given

waveform_observability.verdict: Whole-board efficiency only. No per-device Eon/Eoff, no per-device current/bias/temperature, no switching-cycle waveforms. A whole-board efficiency is NOT a per-device Eon/Eoff.
